summary: Iter 624 (Paket 27 - Stripe inline PaymentElement, children_ages + child pricing, campaign posts→promo_code auto-create + /book?promo= auto-apply, AI EN/DE site translations). Wrote pytest test_iter624_paket27.py with 8 tests — all 8 PASS. Backend: GET /api/payments/config → publishable_key starts with pk_ and inline_enabled=true; POST /api/payments/intent creates Stripe PaymentIntent (client_secret pi_..._secret_..., currency gbp), idempotent (same PI on re-call, stripe_pi_id set on booking), amount uses cart_total (fallback since no deposit_due); /confirm returns paid:false with status requires_payment_method before card entry; unknown booking_id → 404. Child pricing verified numerically: baseline £118 vs children_ages [2,9] → £128 with child_price_per_night=10 (age 2 free under 3, age 9 charged £10). Campaign promo: POST /site-builder auto-creates promo_codes entry (percentage 15%, source campaign_post); /promo-codes/validate returns valid + discount_amount=15 on subtotal 100. AI translate: EN + DE both 200 with translation.headline/about + faqs[1] (Emergent LLM gpt-5.2, ~5s response). Empty body → 422. FRONTEND (/book?property=aldgate-flats&lang=tr&promo=QAKAMP15): guest-picker-trigger → +children x2, child-ages block appears, child-age-0/1 set to 2/9, search-rooms-btn → select-room- adds room, cart-continue-btn → details step renders. promo-applied testid VISIBLE reading 'QAKAMP15 — Kampanya: QA Kampanya' with '-£14' line (Promosyon (QAKAMP15)) auto-applied WITHOUT user typing. summary-child £10 line rendered ('Çocuk ücreti £10'). Total £92 (baseline £97 + £10 child - £14 promo (rounded), page-shown pay-now amount £91). Guest-name/email/phone inputs, payment-card-option, complete-booking-btn → inline-payment-step renders (NOT redirect), inline-amount visible, 13 Stripe frames mounted inside #mhb-payment-element, inline-pay-btn enabled. Site blog: /site/aldgate-flats/blog lists QA Kampanya card; /site/aldgate-flats/blog/qa-kampanya shows site-post-promo='QAKAMP15' and site-post-cta href='/book?property=aldgate-flats&promo=QAKAMP15'. Admin site builder: site-builder-btn present, site-builder-panel renders, site-translations-card + site-tr-ai-btn present, EN/DE lang toggles present, PostsEditor rows expose site-post-promo-0 (value='QAKAMP15') and site-post-pct-0 (value='15').

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Aldgate Flats' from the branch dropdown did not switch activePropertyId in the SiteBuilderPanel (panel kept showing empty/aggregate content, EN tab TR headline field blank). As a result the AI translate button POSTed with empty source and got 422. Backend endpoint is correct — I verified AI translate 200 with valid content via API test. Root cause is in branch switcher wiring for site-builder view (activePropertyId).

issues: No visible EN/DE tab data-testid pair uses site-tr-tab-en/de; instead only site-tr-lang-en/de exist. Spec referenced 'EN tab' — testids differ from prose but are present.

action_items: OPTIONAL FRONTEND: Ensure SiteBuilderPanel picks up branch selection when 'Aldgate Flats' clicked from dropdown while site-builder view is active, so admin can translate a specific property's content without going through the aggregate/default view.

OPTIONAL: When TranslationsEditor's source is empty (headline+about+seo_*+faqs all blank) the AI button currently sends the request and gets a 422 toast. Consider disabling the button (or showing 'İçerik yok' hint) until at least one source field has text — cheaper UX and prevents unnecessary LLM calls.
critical_code_review_comments: be_payments.create_intent: idempotency implemented via booking.stripe_pi_id + Stripe PaymentIntent.retrieve + reusing the same client_secret when status ∈ (requires_payment_method|requires_confirmation|requires_action). Good.
be_payments.confirm_intent: cart-level propagation via cart_master/cart_ref — updates all sibling bookings to paid. Good.
be_payments.ai_translate: uses openai gpt-5.2 through emergentintegrations LlmChat; strips markdown fences; falls back to 502 with clear error on JSON parse fail. Good. lang default 'en' if invalid.

site_builder.save_site: promo_codes upsert with $setOnInsert (id/used_count/created_at) and $set (code/property_id/discount_type/discount_value/description/is_active/source). is_active mirrors post.published — correct.
SearchWidget uses only child-age-<i> as data-testid; children_ages is passed to reserve-multi. Verified end-to-end.
InlinePayment mounts Stripe Payment Element to #mhb-payment-element and gates pay button on state='ready' — 13 Stripe frames observed (payment element + Link).
BookingEngine promo param → pendingPromo → auto-apply visible via [data-testid=promo-applied] once cart proceeds to details step. Confirmed.
